arXiv:2607.20077v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Identifying regions of design space subject to spinodal decomposition is a critical component of alloy design in high-dimensional composition spaces. In cases where designers are seeking to exploit spinodal microstructures to tailor alloy properties, prediction of microstructure evolution and morphology is also needed. In this workflow, coherent strain contributions are captured via high-throughput MLIP elastic constant calculations. arXiv:2507.03853v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce OrbitAll, a geometry- and physics-informed deep learning framework that encodes any molecular system with arbitrary charges, spins, and environmental effects using electronic structure information. OrbitAll demonstrates superior performance and generalization in predicting charged, open-shell, and solvated molecules, and robustly extrapolates to molecules significantly larger than the training data. item.description:

👤 Farah Elnakhal, Alberto Marchisio, Nouhaila Innan, Gabriel Falcao, Muhammad Shafique
arXiv:2607.20045v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Physical noise in near-term quantum hardware is usually treated as a nuisance to suppress. We ask whether it can instead act as a hardware-native regularizer for photonic hybrid quantum-classical neural networks (PHQCNNs), analogous to noise-injection regularization in classical deep learning. A genetic algorithm searches the six continuous noise dimensions and 1 boolean parameter to find, per dataset, the configuration maximizing validation accuracy, compared against a noiseless baseline across five seeds. item.title: Neural networks unlock larger quantum simulations with lower computational costs
item.description:
📚 Physics News
In recent years, research using artificial intelligence to predict material properties has advanced rapidly. Neural network quantum Monte Carlo methods have attracted attention as highly accurate simulation techniques. However, their extremely high computational cost has limited their application to small molecular systems. This study introduces a new computational method that overcomes this limitation.

item.title: 混合LSTM-图神经框架用于鲁棒金融欺诈检测与对抗韧性
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Mariam Zakaria Moussa Ali
本文提出FraudShield AI，将LSTM与手工构造的图拓扑特征结合，用于识别金融交易中的洗钱、分拆转移等复杂欺诈模式。该框架通过PageRank中心性、入度动态和自定义流量比等网络特征，从交易序列与结构关系两个层面刻画异常行为，并利用Focal Loss缓解极端类别不平衡问题。实验在PaySim数据集上显示，该方法在Precision、Recall和F1方面优于逻辑回归与XGBoost等基线，对低金额分拆欺诈尤其有效。

本文开发并评估了一种用于 Belle II 实验电磁量能器的实时图神经网络触发模块。算法将量能器触发晶体单元表示为图节点，用于聚类、特征提取以及逐簇信号分类，并在 FPGA 上实现确定性时延运行，与 Belle II 触发读出系统同步集成。实验结果表明，该系统可维持 MHz 级触发吞吐，端到端时延为 3.168 微秒；在保持能量分辨率与基线算法相当的同时，位置分辨率、簇纯度和簇效率在若干区域均有提升。

arXiv:2607.19610v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An endless radio-frequency (RF) phase shifter is designed using ferroelectric capacitors.
